verdict.rationale: An error-tracking platform could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents a built-in MCP server that lets external AI tools pull GlitchTip data. That is a separate capability: the assistant lives outside the product, and nothing shows an in-product AI assistant that users can hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
